cases.sentence: Он был румяным , с ___ и приятной внешностью.
cases.explain: «красивыми глазами» — after the preposition «с», the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: He sent, and brought him in. Now he was ruddy, with a handsome face and good appearance. Yahweh said, “Arise! Anoint him, for this is he.”

cases.sentence: Дух Господа отошел от Саула, и ___ от Господа мучил его.
cases.explain: «злой дух» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: Now Yahweh’s Spirit departed from Saul, and an evil spirit from Yahweh troubled him.

cases.sentence: Он будет играть, когда ___ от Бога будет находить на тебя, и тебе будет лучше.
cases.explain: «злой дух» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: Let our lord now command your servants who are in front of you to seek out a man who is a skillful player on the harp. Then when the evil spirit from God is on you, he will play with his hand, and you will be well.”

cases.sentence: Саулу становилось легче, и ___ оставлял его.
cases.explain: «злой дух» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: When the spirit from God was on Saul, David took the harp, and played with his hand; so Saul was refreshed, and was well, and the evil spirit departed from him.
